articles.title: Syrians struggle with soaring prices as crisis challenges post-Assad recovery
articles.description: End of subsidies and rising prices drive discontent, testing support for Ahmed al-Sharaa's government.

articles.title: Student-backed election winners demand sweeping resignations in Serbia
articles.description: Days after ousting Aleksandar Vučić's party from power, Student List MPs call for top figures to stand down.

articles.title: Venezuela opposition leader María Machado calls for elections upon return
articles.description: Machado, who was in exile for nearly a year, said the transition in Venezuela's government would be  "irreversible, organised, pacific".

articles.title: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of trying to 'delegitimise' election
articles.description: The PM's Likud party has alleged foreign interference and said Arab-led parties "stole" the election after his coalition lost its majority.

articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself 'leader of Brazil' after election loss
articles.description: The defeated presidential candidate says he will lead the opposition from the US.

articles.title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
articles.description: At least 14 others were wounded in the attack in the central city of Dnipro, including an 11-year-old boy.

articles.title: Philippine police obtain warrant to search Thomas Markle's devices
articles.description: Images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to Meghan's father had reportedly been found in his former home in the Philippines.

articles.title: North Korea fires ballistic missiles off east coast as tensions with South rise
articles.description: North Korea has launched ballistic missiles off its east coast into the Sea of Japan, South Korea said on Thursday, as tensions continued to rise between the two countries.

articles.title: Will she stand? Lagarde quits European Central Bank ahead of French election
articles.description: The French head of the European Central Bank (ECB) is to step down from the role, just months ahead of the troubled country's presidential election.

articles.title: Girl injured in wolf attack at wildlife park
articles.description: An eight-year-old girl has been seriously injured in a wolf attack at a wildlife park in Germany.
